title: Why Dogs Spin Before Lying Down
clip_style: Photorealistic 3D CGI animation in the style of a Blender Cycles render, soft studio lighting, clean bright sky-blue gradient background where outdoors, shallow depth of field, smooth slow camera move, vertical 9:16, no text, no captions.

sections.name: Why dogs spin before lying down

lines.shot: A fluffy golden retriever walks onto a round grey dog bed in a bright modern living room and turns around in a full circle on it, tail wagging. Camera at dog height, slowly pushing in.

lines: You know when your dog spins in circles before it lies down,

lines.shot: Close-up of an empty round plush dog bed on a light wooden floor, perfectly smooth and flat, a dog's paws step into frame. Slow dolly in.

lines: even though its bed is already perfectly flat?

lines.shot: The golden retriever on its bed lifts its head and looks off to the side; a semi-transparent glowing grey wolf silhouette fades in behind it, mirroring its pose. Slow push in.

lines: Well, it might be an instinct left over from its wild ancestors.

lines.shot: Wide shot of a grey wolf walking through waist-high golden grass on an open plain at golden hour, wind moving the grass. Slow tracking shot.

lines: You see, long before dog beds, wild dogs slept outside in tall grass.

lines.shot: Top-down shot of a grey wolf turning in a tight circle in tall green grass, the grass bending under its paws. Camera slowly rotating overhead.

lines: By turning around a few times,

lines.shot: Top-down view of a perfectly round flattened nest of pressed grass in a field of tall grass, the stems bent in a neat spiral. Slow crane down.

lines: they flattened the grass into a soft little nest,

lines.shot: Low macro shot at ground level in tall grass: a small snake and several beetles scurry out of the grass and away as large wolf paws press down. Shallow depth of field.

lines: chased out any bugs or snakes hiding inside,

lines.shot: Close-up of a wolf's face in tall grass, nose lifted and sniffing; faint translucent white wind streaks flow across the frame from left to right, grass swaying the same way.

lines: and figured out which way the wind was blowing,

lines.shot: A wolf lies curled up in a grass nest with its nose pointing into the wind; in the distance faint glowing orange scent trails drift toward its nose. Slow pull back.

lines: so they could smell danger coming while they slept.

lines.shot: Back in the bright living room, the golden retriever turns a second circle on its round dog bed, viewed from a high three-quarter angle. Slow orbit.

lines: So when your dog spins on its bed,

lines.shot: The golden retriever curls up on its dog bed and closes its eyes; tall translucent glowing green grass softly grows up around the bed in the living room, like a memory. Slow push in.

lines: it's still making a nest in grass that isn't there.
